title: Measurement of LLM’s Philosophies of Human Nature

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using the Machine-based Philosophies of Human Nature Scale (M-PHNS), an 84-item psychological questionnaire with a 6-point Likert scale that measures the model's perception of human trustworthiness, altruism, independence, strength of will, complexity, and variability.

Conducting repeated forced-choice experiments in ambiguous scenarios (e.g., financial theft with insufficient evidence) to measure the model's tendency to attribute negative incidents to subjective human malice rather than objective accidents.
